claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b073] Scope decisions for lines 1-223 of this document, logged per instrument rule 5. (a) Condition labels T=0.3 / T=0.7 and run directory names (55maps-text-high-t0.3-generalisation etc.) are treated as names, not claims; the temperatures they encode are asserted as run parameters nowhere in this range. (b) Dates, git hashes, Obs/erratum ids, section references (§3, §4.2), backup-filename timestamps, and precision descriptors ('4 d.p.') are out of scope. (c) '2-annotator'/'2 x 2' used as compound modifiers are names; the cardinal 'two binary annotators' at lines 89-90 is extracted once as a structural count. (d) Cardinal words denoting the four analysed runs are extracted where they assert study scope (lines 1, 30) and skipped where used pronominally as a comparison-set reference ('the smallest of the four'). (e) 'R=50 m' in the 4.1 table row label is folded into the value quantity rather than extracted separately. (f) This document has no sibling JSON in results/55maps-ds-summary-v2/ (report.md is the only file); anchors are the per-run dawid-skene/dawid-skene-results.json, ds-human-crosstab/summary.json and corrected-f1-multi-buffer/summary.json artefacts the report aggregates. Run count has no single manifest artefact enumerating exactly these four D-S fits (results/dawid-skene/ holds a single unrelated fit); flagged anchor-unknown for triage.
